LESSON: ISLAMIC

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.1: Islamic

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Islamic. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Use appropriate manners and dua (supplication)when entering and leaving the Masjid to receive blessings from Allah
2. Appreciate the use of appropriate Islamic manners and dua when entering and leaving the masjid as an act of ibadah Core-Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration Citizenship Self efficacy

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Use appropriate manners and dua (supplication)when entering and leaving the Masjid to receive blessings from Allah
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate manners and dua (supplication)when entering and leaving the Masjid to receive blessings from Allah. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate the use of appropriate Islamic manners and dua when entering and leaving the masjid as an act of ibadah Core-Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration Citizenship Self efficacy
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the use of appropriate Islamic manners and dua when entering and leaving the masjid as an act of ibadah Core-Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration Citizenship Self efficacy. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Islamic.
2. Explain Islamic to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should recite the the Dua 1.
4. Show that you can: Use appropriate manners and dua (supplication)when entering and leaving the Masjid to receive blessings from Allah
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Islamic. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Islamic important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Recite the the Dua 1.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Use appropriate manners and dua (supplication)when entering and leaving the Masjid to receive blessings from Allah
2. Appreciate the use of appropriate Islamic manners and dua when entering and leaving the masjid as an act of ibadah Core-Competencies to be developed: Communication and collaboration Citizenship Self efficacy

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
